packageRules.description: GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks never reach the published package (`files` is lib/ only), so updating one must never release. The actions scope matches the release rule {type: chore, scope: actions, release: false} in .releaserc.cjs for patch, minor and major alike. Every @ivuorinen config package depends on this one at runtime, so each needless release here fans out into Renovate bumps across all of them.

devDependencies never reach consumers, so updating one must never release. The literal prefix is needed because the shared preset's major rule sets commitMessagePrefix 'chore(deps)!: ', which a packageRule can only override, not unset; 'chore(actions)' maps to release: false in .releaserc.cjs. This package has no runtime dependencies, so with this rule a 'chore(deps)!' (a major) can only come from a deliberate manual commit.
pre-commit hook majors: the shared preset restores the 'chore(actions): ' prefix for github-actions majors only, so without this a hook major still arrives as 'chore(deps)!: ' and releases a major.

conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits 10 needs conventional-changelog-writer 9, but semantic-release's release-notes-generator 14 ships writer 8: 10.0-10.3 render notes with only the version heading and 10.4 fails the release. Hold it below 10 (here and in publish.yml's extra_plugins) until a stable release-notes-generator moves to writer 9.
